result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall pick is 1Password if ease of use and employee adoption matter most. Bitwarden is the better value if keeping costs down is a priority.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall experience)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions
- Easy for nontechnical employees
- Strong admin controls and reporting
- Good onboarding and offboarding

Business: approximately \$8.99/user/month. Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for 10 users.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source foundation
- Shared collections for teams
- Admin controls and audit logs
- Strong value for growing businesses

Teams: approximately \$4/user/month.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Good administrative controls
- Shared team folders
- Strong security and compliance features
- Good for businesses with stricter security needs

Business Starter: approximately \$2/user/month.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

- User-friendly interface
- Password health monitoring
- Security alerts and reporting
- Good centralized management

Business pricing varies by plan.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Prices are approximate published annual-billing rates checked in November 2026 and may change. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Excellent | Excellent |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Cost | Higher | Lower |
| Open source | No | Yes |
| Growing teams | Excellent | Excellent |


## What I'd prioritize

Regardless of which one you choose, make sure it offers\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Employees can access company passwords without sharing them through email or Slack.
2. **Role-based permissions\:** Not everyone should see every password.
3. **Easy offboarding\:** Immediately revoke access when someone leaves.
4. **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication.
5. **Audit logs\:** Know who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the right one rather than simply the most popular one.

**1\. How many people are on your team?**

2–5

5–10

10–25

25–50

50+

---

**2\. What's your monthly budget per employee?**

Under \$3

\$3–6

\$6–10

Budget isn't a concern

---

**3\. What's most important?**

Easy to use and manage

Maximum security and control

Secure password sharing

Compliance and audit trails

Lowest possible cost

---

**4\. What does your company primarily use?**

Microsoft 365

Google Workspace

Both

Neither / Other
